name: Upscale Image
description: Makes an image bigger by a factor, with no model: only resampling, so it adds no detail. Lanczos is sharp for photos, nearest keeps pixel art crisp. For detail a model invents, use Upscale with Model. To fit a size, use Resize.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.label: Scale
inputs.description: The factor of each side: 2 makes four times the pixels. Each side is rounded to a whole pixel.

inputs.name: method
inputs.label: Method
inputs.description: lanczos: sharp, for photos. bicubic: softer. bilinear: soft. nearest: hard pixels, for pixel art. area: for making smaller.
